title: Set Overlap Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Diagrams; Knowledge Representation
description: Interactive three-circle Venn diagram built with venn.js and D3 whose sets are ordered process, labeled relationships and feedback. Each of the seven regions shows a definition on hover and two example diagrams on click, and a Classify mode scores six example diagram descriptions with immediate feedback and a reason.

educational.audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners
educational.topic: Classifying diagram types with a Venn diagram
learningObjectives: The learner will classify example diagrams into the correct region of a three-circle Venn diagram of Flowchart, Concept Map and Causal Loop Diagram characteristics.
prerequisites: Definitions of flowchart, concept map and feedback loop

controls.label: Start Classify mode / Back to Explore

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classification with immediate feedback and reasons
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover to define, click for examples, classify with feedback
keyQuestions: Does the diagram have an order of steps, named links, a loop, or several of these?
How is a flowchart's loop back different from a causal feedback loop?
commonMisconceptions: Any diagram with a loop is a causal loop diagram.
Circle sizes in a symbolic Venn diagram represent quantities.
assessmentOpportunities: Classify a new diagram description and justify the region
Score on the six-item Classify mode
